jd_snapshots.title: Medical Writing Specialist

jd_snapshots.title: Medical Specialist - Medical Writing

The role requires a life-science master's degree, 1-2 years of clinical-trial/CRO/pharma experience, regulatory knowledge and accurate English presentation of clinical data.
